findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "evm" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fx_rate, crypto_price · Private data: evm_balances_bulk, payment_verify, sanctions_check, evm_token_info, evm_allowance, evm_nonce, evm_gas_estimate, nft_info, fx_rate, crypto_price, evm_token_balance, evm_wallet_balance, evm_tx, ens_resolve, evm_call, evm_block, evm_code, tx_check, evm_log_decode, contract_audit, wallet_investigate, calldata_decode, tx_batch_status, address_identify, block_at_time, gas_all, base_verdict, base_token_price, cross_chain_quote, mev_sandwich_shield, tx_bundle_plan, token_exit_matrix, robinhood_launch_feed, robinhood_exit_check · Public sink: ens_resolve, tx_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fx_rate, crypto_price · Private data: evm_balances_bulk, payment_verify, sanctions_check, evm_token_info, evm_allowance, evm_nonce, evm_gas_estimate, nft_info, fx_rate, crypto_price, evm_token_balance, evm_wallet_balance, evm_tx, ens_resolve, evm_call, evm_block, evm_code, tx_check, evm_log_decode, contract_audit, wallet_investigate, calldata_decode, tx_batch_status, address_identify, block_at_time, gas_all, base_verdict, base_token_price, cross_chain_quote, mev_sandwich_shield, tx_bundle_plan, token_exit_matrix, robinhood_launch_feed, robinhood_exit_check · Public sink: ens_resolve, tx_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
